proposed_widenings.name: on_use_trigger (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Tactical Shift fires automatically when Second Wind is activated — it is not independently activated. No 'on_use_trigger' or 'passive_rider' family exists in ClassFeatureMechanics. The existing 'activation' family requires an independent activationCost, use_count resource, and resetCadence, none of which apply here. Encoding with a fake resource would produce a dishonest trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you activate your Second Wind with a Bonus Action, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_movement (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect grants movement (up to half Speed) with opportunity attack denial. Neither GrantExtraActionEffect nor HealHpEffect covers this. The v4 taxonomy has 'move' and 'deny_opportunity_attack' atoms, but no surface shape in ClassFeatureEffect exposes them.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks

notes: The structural gap is the missing family: Tactical Shift is a conditional rider on Second Wind's activation, not an independently activated feature. Even if ClassFeatureEffect were widened to include grant_movement, the unit still could not be encoded honestly without a triggered/passive-rider family. Both widenings are required together.
